text_description: A runway look built around a vivid red, coral, black, and pale pink floral-patterned matching set, worn as a sleeveless structured top over a coordinating straight skirt. The upper piece sits close to the body with a high neckline mostly obscured by a dense red feather or petal-like ruffle that wraps around the neck and falls vertically down the center front, continuing over the skirt like a dramatic central trim. The top has broad, clean sleeveless shoulders and visible pocket-like panels on the front, each accented with pale pink wispy feather plumes and small circular metallic ring details; the floral surface reads ornate and textured, with large blossoms and dark scrolling motifs. A narrow horizontal seam separates the top from the skirt at the waist/hip level. The skirt follows the same richly patterned textile and appears slim and column-like, with the red feather trim running down its front. Styling includes black feathered wrist cuffs or bracelets on both wrists and a small rounded dark clutch with a metallic edge held in one hand. The overall mood is opulent, theatrical, and decorative, with saturated floral color, feather volume, and a polished runway presentation.
